articles.summary: GUANGZHOU, China, Aug. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vipshop Holdings Limited (NYSE: VIPS), a leading off-price retailer in China (" Vipshop " or the "Company"), today announced that it plans to release its second quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, before the US market open.
articles.title: Vipshop to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 25, 2026
